notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!
Minor update news:

The character progression was tweaked so that there is no longer a "starting role" quest to complete in order to begin the level with unlockable characters. Feedback wasn't great on that aspect, so it was removed. Unlockable characters now become "recruitable" by beating their main quest. They can then be changed to during the level by visiting a rest point. However, to start the level as the recruitable character, you will have to purchase them to completely unlock them.

The other cool update is that the forest level now has fog and some new vegetation, as well as lighting improvements. The characters have been given a bit of an artistic makeover as well.

Lastly you may see some new and improved user interface being introduced now through the next week or so!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo+ v0.0.1.008
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone!
We’ve got a BIG update packed with new features, abilities, and some exciting changes to the class progression system. Let’s dive in![/b]

[h2]Swap Characters Mid-Level![/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now level up and switch characters during a run!
[*] Find campfires scattered around the realm to swap to unlocked characters.
[*] Character unlocks are based on level thresholds with prerequisite classes.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Example – Want to play as the Knight?
Start the level as a Squire, reach Level 10, and switch to Knight (after purchased) at a campfire.
Or: Reach Level 30 as a Knight once to unlock it as a starting class permanently!
[/list]
[list]
[*] Top-tier classes like Druid and Viking require multiple prerequisites, but they can also be unlocked as starters once you hit Level 30 with them.
[/list]

[h2]Class Abilities Reworked[/h2]
[list]
[*] Each class now has 3 unique active abilities.
[*] Advanced classes can use and level up abilities from their prerequisite class.
[*] Prerequisite classes can’t upgrade advanced class abilities (but can still use if previously unlocked).
[/list]
(e.g. Squire can’t level up Knight skills, but Knight can upgrade Squire skills.)

[h2]7 New Abilities![/h2]
[b]Ranger[/b]
[list]
[*] Bear Trap – Traps and damages enemies.
[*] Seeking Arrow – Hits an enemy, then seeks another target.
[/list]

[b]Wizard[/b]
[list]
[*] Ice Storm (Ultimate) – Slows, freezes, and heavily damages enemies. Evolves from Icebolt.
[/list]

[b]Priestess[/b]
[list]
[*] Martyr’s Fire – Holy damage-over-time that scales with your health regen.
[/list]

[b]Viking[/b]
[list]
[*] Leeching Strikes – Increased crit chance with each hit; crits heal you.
[*] Berserker’s Rhythm – Reduces cooldowns with each hit; resets when you miss.
[/list]

[b]Druid[/b]
[list]
[*] Seismic Shield – Earth shield that stuns and damages on contact.
[/list]

[h2]Balance & System Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Knight: Blood Rage now evolves from Heavy Strike (was Ground Slam).
[*] Viking: Brutal Strikes now evolves from Ground Slam (was Heavy Strike).
[*] Poison Cloud moved from Wizard to Druid.
[/list]

[h2]New Quests & Unlocks[/h2]
[b]15 new quests added![/b]
[list]
[*] 6 Character Starting Role Unlocks – unlock advanced classes to start with.
[*] 9 Ability Unlock Quests – includes the new skills plus Wisp and Pommel from the last update.
[*] New Character Progression Chart added to show unlock paths.
[/list]

[h2]UI & Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Character level now shows in the UI (active character only for now).
[*] Updated stat calculations for better scaling and clarity.
[*] UI navigation improved for new windows.
[*] Known Issue: On controller/Steam Deck, some quest windows may not close properly. You can fix this by hitting Back or toggling the menu window.
[*] A full UI overhaul is in the works for a future update!
[/list]

Thanks so much for playing!
Let us know what you think of the new character progression and mid-run class swap system—we’re excited to keep improving it based on your feedback.

See you in the realm!

notes.title: Demo v0.0.1.006 Update
notes.content:
[b]Realm Survivors - Demo v0.0.1.006 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Features:[/b]

[b]Added "Trials"[/b]
[list]
[*] Deliver resources to support your realm's defenses.
[*] Protect the defenses as they are built.
[*] Enemy kill countdown remains from a previous update.
[*] Rewards scale based on how effectively you complete the trial.
[*] On-screen indicators now show the direction of the trial objective.
[/list]

[b]New Global Consumable Buffs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Double Experience: Doubles experience gained for a set amount of time.
[*] Double Damage: Doubles damage dealt for a set amount of time.
[/list]

[b]UI Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added tooltip images for traits on the trait selection screen, providing controller players with more details about trait effects.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Barrage Fixed (Again): Resolved an issue preventing Barrage from spawning when enemies were out of range. The fix has been tested multiple times and appears to be stable.
[*] Adjusted some enemy projectiles to fix despawning behavior.
[/list]

Thank you for playing Realm Survivors! Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to improve the game. Stay tuned for future updates!

notes.title: Update Demo_v0.0.1.005
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

A new patch is on the way! Here’s a summary of the changes:

[b]New Abilities[/b]
[list]
[*] Pommel – A short-ranged attack that deals damage and stuns enemies.
[*] Wisp – Summons a companion that damages enemies and provides an aura boosting movement speed and regeneration.
[/list]

[b]Breakable Object Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Some AOE abilities can now break objects containing consumables.
[*] Breakable objects now shatter upon player contact—no ability use required.
[*] Improved positioning, lighting, and ground textures to enhance visibility and reduce the "floaty" appearance.
[/list]

[b]Ability Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Meteor Spell – Reduced base AOE size (was too overpowered).
[*] Goblin Bomb – Now damages enemies as well!
[/list]

[b]Experience System Adjustment[/b]
[list]
[*] Experience gain has been significantly modified to reduce the frequency of level-up events, ensuring they don't overshadow gameplay.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed overhead text displaying incorrectly on spawned ghouls.
[*] Fixed an issue where the portal remained after defeating the Forest Witch boss.
[*] Corrected various translation errors.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Barrage ability’s activation countdown wouldn't reset under certain enemy targeting conditions.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon[/b]
[list]
[*]The next update will introduce additional in-level quests ("Trials") and global power-ups!
[/list]

Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback—your input helps make the game even better. Keep the suggestions coming!

notes.title: Demo_v0.0.1.004 Localization Update
notes.content:
Hello Survivors,

In this latest patch we've just added [b]9 new languages (Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Russian)[/b]!

Also made some minor UI adjustments:
[list]
[*] Players can now pick a preferred language in the title screen settings menu.
[*] UI sizing changed in some areas to accommodate added languages.
[*] Made a change to the quest completion notice to be a bit smaller with the option to read more information if desired. Players will know what they unlocked much faster now.
[/list]

If you speak one of the translated languages, please let us know if any of the translations seem off!

Thank you everyone for the recent feedback. Now that localization is completed (well, some tweaking is expected, but its mostly done), will be moving onto a few other fixes, along with content updates. Too soon to say what content updates will make it to the demo vs what will be saved for the Early Access release. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Hot fix: Demo_v0.0.1.003
notes.content:
Demo_v0.0.1.003 Update/Hot Fix Details:

Hello Survivors,

A few minor hot fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed goblin bomb damage from triggering early before animation or indicator.
[*] Added version water-stamp to the top right
[*] Slightly decreased early EXP gain but increased later EXP gain to reduce game-play interruptions from frequent level up canvas pop ups. Will continue to monitor the feel for this.
[*] Fixed an issue that was freezing gameplay when all available abilities were maxed and then level up was not triggering reward pool at early progression levels.
[*] 
[/list]
I had to pause localization development to implement the hot fixes above so there is partial localization implemented in the game with a few texts. The rest will be implemented soon barring any major hold ups.

Please install the latest update for these changes to take effect.

Thank you all for providing feedback to make the game better. Keep it coming!

notes.title: Major update notes
notes.content:
The Demo for Realm Survivors is now live! 

Here are latest updates to the game:
[h2][u][b]
Gameplay Improvements[/b][/u][/h2]
[h3][b]Character Movement:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased baseline movement speed for all characters.
[*] Added invincibility frames (I-frames) during dashes.
[*] Implemented a phasing effect during dashes to move through enemies.
[*] Reduced dash cooldown to 3 seconds (from 4 seconds).
[/list]

[h3][b]Projectiles:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the speed of ranged enemy projectiles.
[*] Increased projectile flight duration.
[*] Meta Progression:
[*] Reduced early-game costs for meta progression upgrades.
[/list]

[h3][b]Abilities:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the training sword's hitbox for improved accuracy.
[*] Increased the hitbox size of the fireball ability for better targeting.
[*] Added a mild knockback effect to the throw stone ability.
[*] Introduced a burn effect to the fireball ability, applying damage over time.
[*] Added visual feedback for when the character is hit: the screen briefly splashes red, and the player’s directional indicator turns red.
[*] Added a root ability for the Mutant Boss.
[*] Modified the Butcher Boss’s charge ability to serve as a primary gap-closer and main attack with large and powerful cleave functionality.
[*] Introduced two new ultimate abilities:
[list]
[*] Barrage
[*] Divine Radiance
[/list]
[/list]

[h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an auto-aim toggle function.
[*] Introduced a reroll functionality for ability selection during level-ups.
[*] Added an unlockable subtrait system; players can equip subtraits after completing associated quests.
[*] Added more quests to complete.
[*] Introduced difficulty settings (Easy, Normal, Hard), modifying enemy health and damage to 80%, 100%, and 150%, respectively.
[*] Added new ground indicators for boss abilities.
[*] Introduced a new enemy: Goblin Bomber—charges the player with a lit bomb.
[*] Added a dynamic spawning system to cap on-screen enemies. Experience gains remain constant as enemies are killed. i.e. the more enemies killed the more exp gained.
[*] Added a new trial mode: Kill Countdown—defeat as many enemies as possible within the time limit. Rewards improve with higher kill counts.
[/list]

[h3][b]Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a back button (gamepad east or Escape on keyboard) for easier menu navigation.
[*] Improved the size and thickness of UI selection borders for better readability.
[*] Removed redundant UI options (e.g., overlapping "X" and "Yes" buttons).
[*] Enabled auto-open/close functionality for character select menus.
[*] Updated default navigation after death or level completion to return to the character select menu.
[*] Clarified quest conditions for unlocking the first character.
[*] Added quest descriptions for locked characters and subtraits.
[*] Introduced several selectable cursor options for better visibility.
[/list]

[b][h2]UI/UX Enhancements[/h2][/b]
[h3][b]HUD and Indicators:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a background to the dash timer for better visibility.
[*] Improved ability bar visuals by adding a background to display ability levels more clearly.
[*] Added descriptive tooltips for global buffs.
[*] Implemented a visible timer for movement speed buffs.
[*] Removed the bank icon and balance from the screen until a game save slot is selected.
[*] Added an overhead health bar for the player character.
[*] Replaced the HUD dash bar with a dash indicator on the overhead health bar.
[/list]

[h3][b]Menus:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed navigation and character selection issues in the character select menu.
[*] Added a stats comparison window to evaluate purchased characters against the currently selected one.
[*] Increased scrolling speed in the upgrades and unlocks menus.
[*] Added a confirmation prompt to prevent accidental exits from the current scene.
[*] Hid the back button in specific menus to avoid unintended scene changes.
[*] Improved menu logic to prevent overlapping, enhancing quality of life and gameplay fluidity.
[*] Visual and Audio Feedback:
[*] Added an opening animation and sound effect for chests.
[*] Enhanced on-screen quest indicators for better visibility.
[*] Improved the intro quest message to prevent repetition.
[*] Added new death sounds and taunts for characters.
[*] Refined visual effects for abilities like Poison and Fire Nova for better clarity and visual impact.
[*] Adjusted UI layouts to fix off-centered elements.
[*] Zoomed the camera out to provide a larger view of the level.
[/list]

[h3][b]Audio Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Overhauled the sound system for improved variety, including dynamic pitch adjustments, instance limits, and enhanced mixing.
[*] Balanced sound levels for many abilities.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in audio mixers for abilities such as Ground Slam, Chain Lightning, and Meteor.
[*] Introduced a sound frequency limit to reduce sound-chaos during large enemy deaths.
[*] Replaced background music with music that has a more appealing tone.
[*] Included navigation sound effects for additional menus.
[/list]

[h1][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h1]
Reduced boss HP to make fights feel less tedious.
Adjusted difficulty scaling to ease early-game progression.

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed banner flickering caused by input during level-ups. Reduced menu navigation speed and added a delay before showing ability options.
[*] Corrected an issue where the level-up menu remained interactable when the main menu was open.
[*] Resolved buggy behavior when rapidly cycling characters in the character select menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where pending upgrades were lost during simultaneous level-ups.
[*] Addressed collider issues, including players getting stuck on spiders, chests, or dead enemies.
[*] Reprogrammed the saving system to prevent errors across playthroughs.
[/list]

[h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Ground indicators for boss abilities and goblin bombs occasionally persist after the enemy is defeated. UPDATE: THIS SHOULD BE NOW FIXED IN LATEST HOTFIX
[*] On-screen quest indicators disappear after one quest is completed. The quest remains completable, but the indicator no longer shows its location. 
[*] The kill count in trials remains cumulative across playthroughs instead of resetting. UPDATE: THIS SHOULD BE NOW FIXED IN LATEST HOTFIX
[/list]

[h1][b]Upcoming Demo Features (Work in Progress)[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Customizable key bindings.
[*] Additional language localization.
[*] Stronger prompting to select a subtrait before starting the level once subtraits are unlocked.
[*] Improved button unselection/highlighting for mouse users. Buttons currently remain selected for gamepad and keyboard navigation of UI.
[*] Expanded trial modes for greater play variety during the level.
[/list]
